title: Compensatory Work Ledger
description: A ledger of recurring work that keeps an institution's routine performance going but is missing from its formal account of operations. Each item records the trigger, who performs the work, who benefits, who bears the cost if it stops, and whether a route to correction exists. A four-question test classifies each item as compensation, discretion, craft, coerced craft, or unresolved. An intervention review then judges a change by trigger count as removal, reduction at source, transfer, or accommodation. Proposed; see docs/planning/compensatory-work-protocol-2026-09.md.

schema_version.title: Schema version
schema_version.description: Version of this schema the ledger conforms to.

unit_ref.title: Unit reference
unit_ref.description: Identifier of the institution unit the ledger covers. Do not use names that identify employers or people unless participants agree.

source.title: Source
source.description: Who built the ledger. A manager's reconstruction is a different source from one kept by the performers and is labeled as one.

items.title: Items
items.description: One entry per recurring item of work.

items.title: Ledger item
items.description: One recurring item of work. The unit is the item, not the person or the team.

item_id.title: Item identifier
item_id.description: Stable identifier for the item, referenced by interventions and residue searches.

trigger.title: Trigger
trigger.description: The condition in the formal process that produces the demand. Interventions are judged by how often this occurs, not by how often the work is done.

work.title: Work
work.description: What the person does, in one sentence, in their words.

frequency_per_month.title: Frequency per month
frequency_per_month.description: Occurrences per month, counted over at least one full cycle of the institution's calendar.

time_basis.title: Time basis
time_basis.description: Whether the work happens on paid, unpaid, or personal time, or a mix.

performer_role.title: Performer role
performer_role.description: Role of the person who does the work.

performer_can_change_trigger.title: Performer can change trigger
performer_can_change_trigger.description: Whether the performer's role holds authority to change the trigger.

beneficiaries.title: Beneficiaries
beneficiaries.description: Who receives the result of the work.

cost_bearers.title: Cost bearers
cost_bearers.description: Who pays if the work is not done.

items.title: Cost bearer
items.description: One party who pays if the work is not done.

formal_record.title: Formal record
formal_record.description: Where the work appears in the institution's own account. An empty list means it appears nowhere.

items.title: Formal record entry
items.description: One place the work is recorded.

correction_route.title: Correction route
correction_route.description: The named route by which this item could be reported, and what has happened to it.

exists.title: Route exists
exists.description: Whether a named route for reporting this item exists.

used.title: Route used
used.description: Whether anyone has used the route for this item.

raised_by_standing.title: Standing of the person who raised it
raised_by_standing.description: Relative standing in the institution of the person who raised the item. Used to compare correction rates.

outcome.title: Outcome
outcome.description: What happened after the item was raised.

tests.title: Classification tests
tests.description: Answers to the four questions in the classification test.

refusal.title: Refusal
refusal.description: What happens if the performer stops doing this: the cost falls on the performer as a penalty, falls on others, or falls on no one.

replacement.title: Replacement
replacement.description: Whether the performer would use a formal route that did the same job at no extra cost to them, or keep doing the work.

ownership.title: Ownership
ownership.description: Whether the performer decides when and how to do the work, and whether the result is credited to them.

institution_depends.title: Institution depends
institution_depends.description: Whether a metric, target, or downstream step is built on the work getting done.

described_as_chosen.title: Described as chosen
described_as_chosen.description: Whether the performer describes the work as their choice. Ask the refusal question first and separately.

classification.title: Classification
classification.description: Result of the classification test. Recorded with the derivation in classification_basis. The performer's account plus documented conditions, not an objective fact.

classification_basis.title: Classification basis
classification_basis.description: One or two sentences saying why, including any disagreement between the performer and others.

interventions.title: Interventions
interventions.description: Reviews of changes made to the process, each judged against one item.

items.title: Intervention review
items.description: One intervention judged against one ledger item.

item_id.title: Item identifier
item_id.description: The ledger item the intervention targets.

trigger_count_before.title: Trigger count before
trigger_count_before.description: Occurrences of the trigger per month at baseline, across the institution unit. Must be greater than zero.

trigger_count_after.title: Trigger count after
trigger_count_after.description: Occurrences of the trigger per month at follow-up, over the same unit and a comparable period.

residue_item_ids.title: Residue item identifiers
residue_item_ids.description: Ledger items in this or adjacent ledgers that share the trigger and appeared or grew after the change. Empty if the residue search found none.

items.title: Residue item identifier
items.description: One item found by the residue search.

reversal_result.title: Reversal result
reversal_result.description: Whether the work returned at its old frequency when the intervention was withdrawn. Withdraw only where that is safe.

preservation.title: Preservation measures
preservation.description: The three things a redesign must not trade away.

performance.title: Performance
performance.description: Change on the outcome measures used before the change, plus any outcome clients care about that was not measured before.

discretion_items_lost.title: Discretion items lost
discretion_items_lost.description: Count of items classified as discretion or craft at baseline that no longer survive, or that someone reports losing a choice over.

surge_response.title: Surge response
surge_response.description: Response to a demand the process did not anticipate, from a natural occurrence or an agreed tabletop scenario.

outcome.title: Outcome
outcome.description: Result of the removal-or-accommodation test, recorded for comparison with the derived value.
